source.question: Why did F-12's oil rate jump after the December 2014 shutdown?

submission.summary: F-12 was shut in for 32 days from 2014-11-30 to 2014-12-31 and restarted at about 4.64 times its pre-shut rate, most likely because water production collapsed and operating conditions were reset. Oil rate per producing day rose from 185.7 Sm3/d in November 2014 to 862.38 Sm3/d in January 2015 while water cut fell from 0.9623 to 0.3107, choke was choked back from 96.52% to 30.33% and WHP rose from 34.61 bar to 70.96 bar.

findings.claim: F-12 was shut in for 32 days from 2014-11-30 to 2014-12-31, field-wide with F-1 C and F-15 D, and oil rate on restart jumped from 184.54 Sm3/d to 859.51 Sm3/d (+366%).
Monthly averages show the jump: November 2014 oil 185.7 Sm3/d at 0.9623 water cut vs January 2015 oil 862.38 Sm3/d at 0.3107 water cut.
The step change is visible day-to-day: 2014-11-13 water cut 0.9631 at 184.54 Sm3/d oil vs 2015-01-02 water cut 0.2242 at 782.75 Sm3/d oil.

Operating conditions were reset on restart: average choke 96.52% at 34.61 bar WHP in November 2014 to 30.33% at 70.96 bar WHP in January 2015, with daily choke 100% before shutdown to 26.5% on 2015-01-02.

The jump is not explained by gauge failure or data artefact; BHP has been failed since 2010-10-12 but the oil and water volumes are measured, and the shut-in was not field-wide for F-14 which kept flowing, indicating a targeted intervention on F-12.

The pattern indicates a well intervention rather than natural pressure build-up: the well returned at about 4.64 times more oil at higher WHP on a much smaller choke, with water cut then rebuilding to 0.4357 in February and 0.7745 by December 2015.

volve_pud.title: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation)

rows: The test interval in well 15/9-19SR flowed with rates up to 1358 Sm3/d and a productivity index of 143 Sm3/D/Bar.
strømmet med rater opp til 1358 Sm3 /d og en produktivitetsindeks på 143 Sm3 /D/Bar.
Mapping of in-place volume was performed in a 14-layer model using zone averages adjusted to well values, with outer bounding faults modeled as inclined and internal faults as vertical.

Kartlegging av tilstedeværende volum har blitt utført i en 14 lags modell med bruk av sonegjennomsnitt tilpasset brønnverdier. Lagmodellen er basert på topp og bunn reservoar flatene fra seismikken samt kartlagte forkastningsplaner. De ytre, begrensende forkastninger på feltet er modellert som skrå, mens forkastninger internt på feltet er modellert som vertikale.

The geological model framework consists of interpreted and depth-converted top and base reservoir surfaces where 14 reservoir zones have been established using stratigraphic modeling based on regional isochores from the Sleipner area together with well data.
hvor det er etablert 14 reservoarsoner ved bruk av stratigrafisk modellering basert på regionale isokorer fra Sleipnerområdet sammen med brønndataene.
The operator's annual operating cost at plateau rate for well intervention costs is 27 million NOK 2005 per 12 months production.
Well 15/9-19SR discovered oil in the Volve structure in 1993.
Brønn 15/9- 19SR påviste i 1993 olje i strukturen
Well 15/9-19A was drilled in 1996 and proved a much thicker reservoir than the discovery well.
Brønn 15/9-19A ble boret i 1996 og påviste et mye tykkere reservoar enn funnbrønnen.
Well 15/9-19B was drilled in 1997 in a segment outside the field and the reservoir was water-filled there.
Brønn 15/9-19B ble boret i 1997 i et segment utenfor feltet og her var reservoaret vannfylt.
Both wells in the oil zone have been production tested and showed good production properties.
Begge brønner i oljesonen har blitt produksjonstestet og viste gode produksjonsegenskaper.
